description_en: Queries the list of unassigned servers in a hybrid cloud cluster
description_zh: 查询混合云集群未分配服务器列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-unassigned-machines --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-5yd00007009 --cluster-id 123 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudUnassignedMachines

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation and obtain the Id field value of the target hybrid cloud cluster from the ClusterInfos array in the response. If no cluster is available, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2980286.html operation to create a hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html接口，从返回结果的 ClusterInfos 数组中找到目标混合云集群，取其Id 字段值。若尚无可用集群，可调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2980286.html 接口新建混合云集群
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the server
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
